iiit_jabalpur.NAME: PDPM IIITDM Jabalpur
iiit_jabalpur.CAMPUS_HINT: (Dumna Airport Road campus, Jabalpur 482005; units are often called 'Disciplines')
iiit_jabalpur.SPECIAL:
* This is an IIIT (PDPM Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing Jabalpur), not an IIT: wherever this brief says 'IIT' or 'this IIT', read 'this institute'.
* Look-alikes that are NOT this institute: IIITDM Kancheepuram (Chennai), IIITDM Kurnool, Jabalpur Engineering College, IIIT Jabalpur does not exist as a separate body. Faculty 'on contract' / 'temporary faculty' listed on the institute's faculty pages count as faculty (keep the designation).
* If the institute was mentored by another institute in its first years, mentor faculty who only taught are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from X (Y1-Y2)").

iiit_gwalior.NAME: ABV-IIITM Gwalior
iiit_gwalior.CAMPUS_HINT: (Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management, Morena Link Road, Gwalior 474015; includes the management faculty)
iiit_gwalior.SPECIAL:
* This is an IIIT (Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management Gwalior, 'ABV-IIITM'), not an IIT: wherever this brief says 'IIT' or 'this IIT', read 'this institute'.

Faculty 'on contract' listed on the institute's faculty pages count as faculty (keep the designation).

iiit_kancheepuram.NAME: IIITDM Kancheepuram
iiit_kancheepuram.CAMPUS_HINT: (Indian Institute of Information Technology, Design and Manufacturing Kancheepuram, Melakottaiyur / Vandalur-Kelambakkam Road, Chennai 600127)
iiit_kancheepuram.SPECIAL:
* This is an IIIT (IIITDM Kancheepuram, Chennai), not an IIT: wherever this brief says 'IIT' or 'this IIT', read 'this institute'.
* IIITDM Kancheepuram was set up with IIT Madras as mentor: IIT Madras faculty who only taught/mentored are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from IIT Madras (Y1-Y2)"); someone who held a post at IIITDM (Director, Dean, regular appointment) is regular faculty.
* Look-alikes that are NOT this institute: IIITDM Jabalpur, IIITDM Kurnool, IIT Madras, VIT Chennai, Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering. Faculty 'on contract' listed on the institute's faculty pages count as faculty (keep the designation).

iiit_allahabad.NAME: IIIT Allahabad

iiit_allahabad.SPECIAL:
* This is an IIIT (Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad), not an IIT: wherever this brief says 'IIT' or 'this IIT', read 'this institute'.
* Look-alikes that are NOT this institute: MNNIT Allahabad, University of Allahabad, IIIT Agartala ('IIITA' is ambiguous), IIIT Lucknow. Faculty 'on contract' listed on the institute's faculty pages count as faculty (keep the designation).

iiit_bangalore.NAME: IIIT Bangalore
iiit_bangalore.CAMPUS_HINT: (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore, Electronics City, Bengaluru 560100; include research centres/labs listed by the institute)
iiit_bangalore.SPECIAL:
* This is an IIIT (International Institute of Information Technology Bangalore, 'IIIT-B'), not an IIT: wherever this brief says 'IIT' or 'this IIT', read 'this institute'.
* Look-alikes that are NOT this institute: IIIT Bhubaneswar and IIIT Bhagalpur ('IIIT-B' is ambiguous), IIIT Dharwad, IIIT Raichur, REVA University. IIIT-B lists many adjunct / visiting / industry faculty: they are `adjunct` / `visiting` (they only contribute papers that print IIIT-B's affiliation). Research staff of centres are excluded unless the institute lists them as faculty.

iiit_pune.NAME: IIIT Pune
iiit_pune.CAMPUS_HINT: (Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, founded 2016 as a PPP IIIT; transit campus(es) in Pune and permanent campus at Nanoli, Talegaon: establish every campus, its address and PIN, and the years used, and record them in the notes)
iiit_pune.SPECIAL:
* This is an IIIT (Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune, 'IIITP'), not an IIT: wherever this brief says 'IIT' or 'this IIT', read 'this institute'.
* **Look-alike to keep out:** the private 'International Institute of Information Technology (I2IT / I²IT), Hinjawadi, Pune' (isquareit.ac.in) is a different organisation; also AISSMS IOIT, Vishwakarma Institute of Information Technology, PICT, COEP. If IIIT Pune had a mentor institute in its first years, mentor faculty who only taught are `visiting` ("Mentor faculty from X (Y1-Y2)"). Faculty 'on contract' listed on the institute's faculty pages count as faculty (keep the designation).

iiit_hyderabad.NAME: IIIT Hyderabad
iiit_hyderabad.CAMPUS_HINT: (International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad, Gachibowli, Hyderabad 500032; include every research centre / lab listed by the institute, e.g. CVIT, LTRC, KCIS, CSTAR, Spatial Informatics, Building Science, Robotics, CogSci, Data Sciences, Security, VLSI, and the humanities / natural sciences units)
iiit_hyderabad.SPECIAL:
* This is an IIIT (International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad, 'IIIT-H'), not an IIT: wherever this brief says 'IIT' or 'this IIT', read 'this institute'.
* IIIT Hyderabad is organised in research centres rather than departments: use the centre as `department` (primary centre; others in the notes). Research scientists / research staff are excluded unless the institute's faculty list shows them as faculty; adjunct, visiting, honorary and 'professor of practice' people are `adjunct` / `visiting` (they only contribute papers that print IIIT-H's affiliation).
* Look-alikes that are NOT this institute: IIT Hyderabad (Kandi/Sangareddy), University of Hyderabad (also in Gachibowli), ISB, IIIT Naya Raipur, IIIT Bhubaneswar, the Department of Information Technology of Hyderabad engineering colleges (MLR, Vardhaman, GNITS, CBIT …).
